usage:
usage:
  personad manager maintenance prepare|observe|recovery-recipe --help
                       preserve exact-session recovery material; no exit, restore or update execution
  personad manager update check|start|status|run|confirm|rollback --plan PATH
                       inspect or activate one explicit independent manager release plan
  personad manager update inventory --plan PATH --main ID --machine ID --machine-uid UID
                       read persisted main identity and two complete local node activity snapshots; writes nothing
  personad manager join <hub address> <install code> [--dir directory] [--database-url URL] [--fingerprint fingerprint] [--install]
                       trade the install code from New assistant in the app for this assistant's token and write manager.json
                       (default ~/.persona/managers/<id>); its own Postgres is created in Docker by install
                       (container persona-mgr-<id>-pg), or supplied with --database-url
  personad manager join --builtin <hub address> [<code>] [--fingerprint <fingerprint>] [--install]
                       bind the built-in manager's own service to the hub with a code from persona-hub manager-code
                       (given, or in PERSONA_MANAGER_CODE, which other users of the machine cannot read; the binding
                       goes into ~/.persona/managers/assistant/manager.json); --install: then install its service
  personad manager run [--dir directory] [--join <hub address> <install code>]
                       run this manager (--join: trade the code first when manager.json is absent; for containers)
  personad manager install [--dir directory]     create its own Postgres (Docker) and install a persistent service (Linux: systemd user service; Mac: launchd)
  personad manager uninstall [--dir directory] [--purge]
                       stop and remove the persistent service; stop its database container but keep the volume (--purge: remove both)
  personad manager capabilities [--json]   list this program's manager capabilities without changing anything
  personad manager status [--dir directory]      managers on this computer and their services
  personad manager search-reindex [--dir <directory>]
                       empty this manager's chat search index in its database: it reads its chats again from the
                       start
  personad manager install --builtin [--join <hub address>] | --check
                       install the built-in manager's own service (Linux: systemd user unit persona-manager-assistant;
                       Mac: launchd); --join: bind it first with the code in PERSONA_MANAGER_CODE, unless its binding
                       works (persona-hub setup does this); --check: only say whether it can be installed here
  personad manager uninstall --builtin    stop and remove that service; its binding and data stay
  personad manager status --builtin       the built-in manager's binding and service
flag_dir: the manager's directory (optional when this computer has only one manager)
systemd_user_unreachable_detail: cannot reach your systemd user instance: {error}
systemd_user_unreachable: cannot reach your systemd user instance
service_manual: run it persistently yourself: {binary} manager run --dir {directory} (tmux, nohup, or a container)
installed_systemd:
Installed: manager "{name}" ({id}) is running as systemd user service {unit}.
  Log: journalctl --user -u {unit} -f
linger_disabled: Linger is off: the service stops when you log out. Run sudo loginctl enable-linger {user} to keep it running
installed_launchd:
Installed: manager "{name}" ({id}) is launchd service {label} and runs when you log in.
  Log: {log}
service_unsupported: persistent services are not supported on {os}; {manual}
uninstall_directory_kept: Directory {directory} was kept. Delete this assistant in the app so the hub stops accepting its token.
uninstall_database_given: The database came from --database-url and was left unchanged.
uninstall_database_none: This manager has no database yet.
uninstall_database_stop_failed: Database container {container} could not be stopped ({error}); it and data volume {volume} were kept.
uninstall_database_stopped: Database container {container} stopped. Data volume {volume} and its data were kept: install again to reuse them, or add --purge to delete the data too.
uninstall_database_remove_failed: Could not remove database container {container} and data volume {volume}: {error}
uninstall_database_config_failed: Removed database container {container} and data volume {volume} (their data is gone), but manager.json could not be updated: {error}
uninstall_database_removed: Removed database container {container} and data volume {volume}; their data is gone. Installing again creates a new empty database.
service_not_installed: Manager {id} is not installed as a service ({path} is absent)
service_none_on_os: No persistent service is installed on {os}
container_docker_missing: Docker is not installed; cannot check
container_docker_denied: the current user cannot use Docker; cannot check
container_docker_down: Docker is not running; cannot check
service_unsupported_os: services are not installed on this operating system
join_old_database_unused: Its former database container {container} (data volume {volume}) is no longer used and was not removed. To delete them, run docker rm -f {container} && docker volume rm {volume}
join_config_write_failed: Could not write {path}: {error} (the token was traded; get a new install code in the app and try again)
join_code_missing: No install code. Get one in the app under Settings > Assistants > New
join_plaintext_public: Hub address {hub} uses plaintext http on the public internet, so the traded token would cross it in the clear. Use the hub's https address (TLS port), or add --allow-plaintext if you really need plaintext
join_code_refused: The hub rejected this install code: it is invalid, expired (10 minutes), or already used. Get a new code for this assistant in the app
join_tls_required: The hub does not allow plaintext code exchange over the public internet, and this install code is now void. Get a new code in the app and use the hub's https address (TLS port)
join_http_forbidden: The hub refused the code exchange (HTTP 403): {error}
join_code_conflict: the hub did not trade the code, which is still good (HTTP 409): {error}
join_rate_limited: Too many attempts. The hub is temporarily refusing code exchanges from this computer; try again in a few minutes
join_hub_too_old: Hub {hub} does not support managers yet (HTTP {status}); upgrade the hub first
join_http_error: The hub could not complete the code exchange (HTTP {status}): {error}
join_bad_reply: The hub returned an invalid reply: id or token is missing
flag_join_database_url: its Postgres database (default: install creates one in Docker)
flag_join_fingerprint: the hub's TLS fingerprint (for an https address using the hub's own certificate)
flag_join_allow_plaintext: allow a plaintext http hub address on the public internet (the token crosses it in the clear)
flag_join_install: install the persistent service after joining (manager install)
join_database_own: its own Postgres, created in Docker by install (container {container})
join_next: Next: {program} manager install --dir {directory} (install the service), or run {program} manager run --dir {directory} in the foreground
flag_run_join: when manager.json is absent, first trade the following <hub address> <install code>
flag_run_database_url: with --join: its Postgres database (provided by a container through the {env} environment variable, not on the command line)
flag_run_allow_plaintext: with --join: allow a plaintext http hub address on the public internet
run_join_waiting: manager: could not join the hub, and rerunning the same command will not help: {error}. Waiting: get a new install code in the app and rerun the new install command (a container that never joined is recreated with the new code), or run personad manager join <hub address> <install code> --dir {directory}
run_token_revoked: manager: [{id}] the hub no longer accepts this manager's token (deleted in the app or reinstalled elsewhere). It will stay disconnected and retry every {retry}. To keep using this directory, get a new install code in the app and run personad manager join <hub address> <install code> --dir {directory}
database_missing: This manager has no database. Install Docker to create its own Postgres container, or add --database-url 'postgres://USER:PASSWORD@HOST:5432/DBNAME' (the install code was not spent)
database_docker_denied: Docker is installed, but the current user cannot use it for the manager's Postgres. Run sudo usermod -aG docker {user}, log out and back in, then retry; or add --database-url
database_docker_down: Docker is installed but not running. Run sudo systemctl start docker (on Mac, open Docker Desktop or OrbStack), then retry
database_not_ready: Its database is not ready: {error} (run docker logs {container} for the reason)
database_lost: manager: [{id}] its database container {container} and data volume {volume} are both gone. Created a new empty database; previous chats, settings, and inbox items are not in it
database_made: created its own Postgres (Docker container {container}, data volume {volume})
database_existing: its own Postgres (Docker container {container}, data volume {volume})
only_manager_none: No managers under {directory}: run personad manager join first, or specify a directory with --dir
only_manager_many: This computer has {count} managers ({directories}); specify one with --dir
token_renewed: manager: [{id}] manager.json has a new token; reconnecting to the hub
token_accepted: manager: [{id}] the hub accepts this token again; reconnecting
